Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Raid Buff Off (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Cancel selected buffs during combat in selected areas.
Description: Global client. Cancel selected raid buffs only in checked Ultimate raids during combat. Three-column job-grouped checkbox list uses current PvE status IDs and includes AST's The Balance and The Spear. Seven Ultimate areas only. DTR raidbuff: left-click ON/OFF, right-click settings. Open /rbo. Defaults OFF with empty selections.
Changelog: 0.1.2.0: Arrange raid-buff checkboxes as three jobs per row. Remove the show-current-buffs and show-selected-only filters. Keep search, job collapse controls, and checkbox selections.
